data.one_liner: Widget that adds pinch‑to‑zoom and fullscreen zoom to any child widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides pinch‑to‑zoom on the embedded view and a tap‑to‑fullscreen mode with zoom, pan, double‑tap and swipe‑down to dismiss. It uses a Hero animation for smooth transitions.
use_when: You need simple zoom functionality for images or other widgets
You want a quick fullscreen preview with zoom without building custom gestures
You prefer a lightweight solution with minimal setup
avoid_when: You require a gallery or carousel with multiple zoomable items
You need highly custom zoom gestures or advanced animation control
You need support for non‑image widgets beyond the planned future feature
strengths: Very easy to integrate – just wrap your widget
Supports both embedded pinch‑to‑zoom and fullscreen mode
Provides Hero transition and double‑tap zoom out of the box
weaknesses: Only works with a single widget at a time
Limited customization of gestures and UI
Zoom on arbitrary widgets is not yet supported
